fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (38.328544,-85.82367, GEOMETRIC_CENTER) landed on the large industrial complex at 707 Pillsbury Lane, New Albany IN - correct site. Locked center 38.3284,-85.8240.
fieldNotes.ownership: OWNERSHIP CHANGE - this is the former General Mills Pillsbury dough/biscuit plant (founded 1959, ~460,000 sq ft). General Mills closed it in 2016 and sold it (via New Mill Capital / Tiger Group) to The Sazerac Company in June 2018. It now operates as Northwest Ordinance Distilling (Sazerac), a spirits processing/blending/bottling/distribution facility, ~200+ employees. The roster's General Mills attribution (Hyster GM plant list) is stale; the physical freight facility is audited as it stands today.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence (visible in 2026-03 Street View along Pillsbury Lane). Trucks enter via Pillsbury Lane from the E; z19 satellite shows a checkpoint pinch-point with striped/yellow markings at the E entrance to the fenced yard. Treated as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly resolvable standalone guard booth; an angular dark-roofed building near the SE entrance may be an office/visitor structure rather than a gate booth. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true - fenced/gated truck yard without a confirmed staffed booth. Low confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Pillsbury Lane runs a long stretch from the E public-road network through the fenced approach before reaching docks - deep stacking room.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: The S-side access road and dock approach runs immediately against a dense residential neighborhood; a truck queue at the gate or along the dock road would be tight against housing and could choke the road - backup-sensitive geometry.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank along the S building wall with ~25-40 trailers/positions. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop-trailer rows along the S access road and in the W silo yard - roughly 15-25 stalls. Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows present (S access road and W yard).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Primary dock activity is on the S building face; W-side loading is minor and tied to the silo/storage operation - treated as a single ship/receive dock cluster.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits inside New Albany (part of the Louisville metro), hemmed by dense residential neighborhoods on the S and other industrial/commercial properties - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the E edge of the property in a grass corridor and historically may have served the Pillsbury plant, but no active spur is clearly visible entering the fenced yard in current imagery. Set false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~43 acres covering the building and active yard; published parcel figures vary (34.5 to 58 acres).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large interconnected manufacturing complex; counted as a single building.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery - flagged uncertain.
